title: Seed Component Specialization Relationship Support
description: Conservative support objects for the seed Retriever and Reranker specialization relationships. This support records maintainer rationale for including declared specialization edges in the seed dataset and does not claim external factual proof, benchmark superiority, or universal RAG taxonomy behavior.

references.title: RKM Seed Component Specialization Modeling Rationale
references.abstract: Internal maintainer analysis describing why seed Retriever and Reranker records are connected to existing Component records through conservative specialization relationships.
notes: This reference records seed dataset modeling rationale and should not be treated as external factual proof.

claims.statement: RELATIONSHIP-10201 is included as seed dataset modeling rationale because Lexical Retriever is modeled as a more specific seed entity aligned with the Keyword Retriever component.
claims.rationale: The claim explains seed dataset modeling rationale and avoids asserting a universal taxonomy or external factual proof.
